Granahan Investment Management Inc decreased its stake in Nexstar Media Group (NXST) by 28.12% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Granahan Investment Management Inc sold 35,461 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.98% with the market. The hedge fund held 90,647 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.09 million, down from 126,108 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Granahan Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Nexstar Media Group for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.97B market cap company. (NASDAQ:NXST) has declined 3.18% since April 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.73% the S&P500.
